children: Brazil's central bank will soon announce a "relevant measure" aimed at curbing indebtedness in higher-cost credit segments, the bank's director of supervision Ailton Aquino said on Tuesday.

Speaking at an event hosted by Zetta, an association representing financial and payments institutions, Aquino said credit card lending and unsecured consumer loans have been the main drivers of rising household indebtedness.
